Abdul Barik and others  ------ Respondents
full_judgment:
The respondent No.1 as plaintiff filed Title Suit No. 02 of 2000 in the Court of the learned Assistant judge, Monohardi, Narsingdi for declaration of title over .09 acre of land and for further declaration that RS. Khatian No. 39 in respect of .09 acre in the name of Hatirdia Rajiuddin College is wrong and incorrect. 

 3. The case of the plaintiffs, inter-alia, is that the schedule properties appertaining C.S. Khatian No. 129 S.A. Khatian 87 and RS. Khatian No. 39 plot No. 116 measuring 9 decimals of properties under District Norsingdi within thana Monohardi of Hatirdia Monza originally belongs to Sharfat Ali, Sadat Ali and Suzat Ali who got the properties in equal share. Accordingly their names were prepared in C.S. khatian in equal share. Subsequently Sadat Ali became the owner and possessor of plot No. 155 under C.S. Khatian No. 129. Sadat Ali had no child in pursuance of that the said Sadat Ali took Alauddin son of Ibrahim Bhuiyan as an adopted son. Thereafter Sadat Ali gifted the schedule properties to Alauddin by a registered Heba-Bil-Ewaz deed No. 4477 dated 19.04.1960 and put him into possession. Subsequently he mutated his name vide mutation Case No. 183 of 1992-93 dated 11.01.1993. After on words the said Alauddin proposed to the plaintiff for making an exchange deed with him in respect of the suit properties due to his personal difficulties. The plaintiff agreed to exchange. Accordingly, an exchange deed was made between them on 03.06.1999. As a result, the plaintiff became the owner of the schedule properties on the basis of the said exchange deed and he was possessing the suit land within the knowledge of all the persons. But R.S. Khatian was wrongly prepared in the name of Hatirdia Raziuddin College represented by the Secretary, Hence the plaintiff was compelled to bring this suit for declaration of title along with a declaration that the R.S. Khatian was wrongly prepared. 

 4. The defendant No.1 contested the suit by filing written statement denying the material facts in the plaint. The written statement filed by the defendant No.1 stated that the suit is not maintainable in its present form and manner. The suit is hatred by limitation and by principles of waiver and estoppels and acquiesces. The defendant No.1 stated in his written statement that admittedly Sadat Ali and his two brothers were the owners and possessors of the suit properties. Accordingly their names were recorded in C.S. Khatian properly. They also admitted the right, title and interest of Alauddin. But the &defendant No.1 also stated in his written statement that after the death of Sharafat Ali and Sadat Ali, Raziuddin Bhuiyan and Alauddin became the owner and possessor and they handed over .23 decimals of properties under C.S. Plot No.155 to the defendant No.1 by a registered deed dated 18.02.1966. Subsequently said Alauddin with others donee executed a registered rectification deed on 15.03.1994. Accordingly the defendant No.1 had been possessing the suit properties by constructing huts, digging earth rearing fishes and cultivating banana and various plants thereon. R.S. Khatian was prepared properly. The said exchange deed has been made collusively and the plaintiff did not get possession, as such the suit is liable to be dismissed.
